# ==============================================================================
# REPORT DIAGNOSTICS: Check if RMarkdown report can run
# ==============================================================================
# Run this BEFORE knitting the RMarkdown report to check for issues

cat("\n=== IHDS REPORT DIAGNOSTICS ===\n\n")

# 1. Check Working Directory
cat("1. Checking working directory...\n")
expected_wd <- "C:/Users/ashwin/Desktop/IIHDS_Project"
current_wd <- getwd()

if (current_wd == expected_wd) {
  cat("   ✓ Working directory correct:", current_wd, "\n")
} else {
  cat("   ✗ Working directory mismatch!\n")
  cat("     Current:", current_wd, "\n")
  cat("     Expected:", expected_wd, "\n")
  cat("   → Fix: Run setwd('", expected_wd, "')\n", sep = "")
}

# 2. Check Required Packages
cat("\n2. Checking required packages...\n")
required_packages <- c("haven", "dplyr", "tidyverse", "ggplot2", "scales", 
                      "knitr", "kableExtra", "broom", "rmarkdown")

missing_packages <- c()
for (pkg in required_packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE, quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("   ✗", pkg, "NOT installed\n")
    missing_packages <- c(missing_packages, pkg)
  } else {
    cat("   ✓", pkg, "\n")
  }
}

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  cat("\n   → Installing missing packages...\n")
  install.packages(missing_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
}

# 3. Check Required Output Files
cat("\n3. Checking required output files...\n")
required_files <- c(
  "output/analysis_data.rds",
  "output/tables/wealth_by_group.csv",
  "output/tables/model_employment_key_vars.csv",
  "output/tables/marginal_effects.csv",
  "output/tables/muslim_profile.csv",
  "output/models/model_employment_main.rds",
  "output/tables/model_fit_statistics.csv"
)

missing_files <- c()
for (file in required_files) {
  if (file.exists(file)) {
    cat("   ✓", file, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("   ✗", file, "NOT FOUND\n")
    missing_files <- c(missing_files, file)
  }
}

if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  cat("\n   → Run analysis pipeline first:\n")
  cat("     source('scripts/run_analysis.R')\n")
}

# 4. Check RMarkdown File
cat("\n4. Checking RMarkdown file...\n")
rmd_files <- c("docs/analysis_report.Rmd", "main_analysis.Rmd")
rmd_found <- FALSE

for (rmd in rmd_files) {
  if (file.exists(rmd)) {
    cat("   ✓ Found:", rmd, "\n")
    rmd_found <- TRUE
  }
}

if (!rmd_found) {
  cat("   ✗ RMarkdown file not found\n")
  cat("   → Expected location: docs/analysis_report.Rmd\n")
}

# 5. Test Data Loading
cat("\n5. Testing data loading...\n")
if (all(file.exists(required_files[1:5]))) {
  tryCatch({
    test_data <- readRDS("output/analysis_data.rds")
    cat("   ✓ analysis_data.rds loaded:", nrow(test_data), "rows\n")
    
    test_wealth <- read.csv("output/tables/wealth_by_group.csv")
    cat("   ✓ wealth_by_group.csv loaded:", nrow(test_wealth), "rows\n")
    
    test_model <- read.csv("output/tables/model_employment_key_vars.csv")
    cat("   ✓ model_employment_key_vars.csv loaded:", nrow(test_model), "rows\n")
    
    test_ame <- read.csv("output/tables/marginal_effects.csv")
    cat("   ✓ marginal_effects.csv loaded:", nrow(test_ame), "rows\n")
    
    test_muslim <- read.csv("output/tables/muslim_profile.csv")
    cat("   ✓ muslim_profile.csv loaded:", nrow(test_muslim), "row(s)\n")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("   ✗ Error loading data:", e$message, "\n")
  })
} else {
  cat("   ⊘ Skipped (missing files)\n")
}

# 6. Summary
cat("\n=== DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY ===\n")
all_good <- (
  current_wd == expected_wd &&
  length(missing_packages) == 0 &&
  length(missing_files) == 0 &&
  rmd_found
)

if (all_good) {
  cat("✓ ALL CHECKS PASSED - Ready to knit report!\n\n")
  cat("To generate report, run:\n")
  cat("  rmarkdown::render('docs/analysis_report.Rmd')\n\n")
} else {
  cat("✗ ISSUES FOUND - Fix the problems above before knitting\n\n")
  
  if (current_wd != expected_wd) {
    cat("→ Fix working directory first\n")
  }
  if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
    cat("→ Install missing packages\n")
  }
  if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
    cat("→ Run analysis pipeline: source('scripts/run_analysis.R')\n")
  }
  if (!rmd_found) {
    cat("→ Create RMarkdown file at: docs/analysis_report.Rmd\n")
  }
}

# 7. Quick Test Knit (optional)
cat("\n=== OPTIONAL: TEST KNIT ===\n")
cat("Want to test-knit the report now? (y/n): ")

# For non-interactive environments, skip this
if (interactive()) {
  response <- readline()
  if (tolower(response) == "y" && all_good) {
    cat("\nAttempting to knit report...\n")
    tryCatch({
      rmarkdown::render(
        "docs/analysis_report.Rmd",
        output_file = "analysis_report.html",
        output_dir = "docs/",
        quiet = FALSE
      )
      cat("\n✓ SUCCESS! Report generated at: docs/analysis_report.html\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("\n✗ Knitting failed:\n")
      cat(e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
} else {
  cat("(Skipped - non-interactive session)\n")
}

cat("\n=== DIAGNOSTICS COMPLETE ===\n")
